results.content: # Median US income rises to highest on record even as Americans feel affordability pinch. Americans’ median household income rose 2.6% or $87,460, in 2025, the first year of President Donald Trump’s second term, according to Census Bureau data released on Tuesday. This is the highest household income, which is adjusted for inflation, since the agency started measuring it in 1967. The poverty rate for children fella percentage point to 13.4%, the lowest on record. “This has been the most successful two years financially and every other way in the history of the presidency,” Trump said at the Republican National Convention on Wednesday. Median income barely rose during the Biden administration
